sink:
Public WithEvents Sheet As Worksheet
Public WithEvents Book As Workbook
Public WithEvents App As Application
Private Sub Sheet_Calculate()
Log = Log & "sheet;"
End Sub
Private Sub Book_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
Log = Log & "book;"
End Sub
Private Sub App_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
Log = Log & "app;"
End Sub
helpers:
Public Log As String
Public Calls As Long
Function Tick(ByVal x As Double) As Double
Calls = Calls + 1
Tick = x * 2
End Function

probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.Calculation = -4105
Range("A1").Value2 = 1
Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
Application.Calculate
Application.Calculation = -4135
Range("A1").Value2 = 5
Dim before As String
before = CStr(Range("B1").Value2) & ":" & CStr(Calls)
Dim listener As New ExcelSink
Set listener.Sheet = ActiveSheet
Probe = before & "|" & CStr(Range("B1").Value2) & ":" & CStr(Calls)
Application.EnableEvents = True
Log = ""
Application.Calculate
Probe = Probe & "|" & CStr(Range("B1").Value2) & ":" & CStr(Calls) & ":" & Log
Application.EnableEvents = False
End Function
probes.name: manual_sheet_ordinary
